address: 5727 College Ave, Oakland (the Rockridge Trader Joe's)
role: III.D contrast: a pending application near Rockridge BART that relies on the State Density Bonus Law, not SB 79.
caveat: Facts below come from news reports and a neighborhood advocacy group's fact sheet, quoted from data/rockridge/sources. The primary record is Oakland's project file (Planning No. ZW2601986; preliminary application ZP260014). The memo uses the project only to illustrate how the two laws differ and takes no position on the application.
